summary.text: Sarah Liguori is a Democratic member of the Arizona House of Representatives representing District 5; she was appointed on February 8, 2024, by the Maricopa County Board of Supervisors to replace Jennifer Longdon.

paragraphs.text: She represented District 28 in the House from 2021 to 2023.
She lives in Phoenix, earned a degree from the University of Arizona, and has worked as a manager with RDLR Development.
She advanced from the July 21, 2026 Democratic primary and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot.
